author: GameTrailers
description:
From Warner Bros. Games and DC, in this new cinematic, the LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight video game recreates the iconic sequence seen in DC's Batman (1989) movie in which The Joker takes over the Gotham City museum, turning it into his own personal art gallery. Delightfully reimagined in LEGO form, the fun-filled moment is set against the backdrop of the “Partyman” song by legendary musician Prince, which was famously debuted in the classic film.

Build the Legacy May 29, 2026. The game will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official Cinematic Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026

description:

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Marvel MaXimum Collection reveal trailer for this upcoming fighting game collection. Marvel MaXimum Collection features X-Men: The Arcade Game, Spider-Man/X-Men: Arcade's Revenge, Captain America and the Avengers, Spider-Man/Venom: Maximum Carnage, Venom/Spider-Man: Separation Anxiety, and Silver Surfer. Additional features also include Rollback Netcode in X-Men: The Arcade Game, Save Anywhere, In-game Rewind, Museum, and more. Marvel MaXimum Collection will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S and Steam.

Marvel MaXimum Collection is action-packed, featuring 13 comic-to-console and handheld counterpart titles from the past. And of course, arcade perfection is delivered with the legendary X-Men: The Arcade Game! With all new music from legendary game composer Chris Huelsbeck and robust new features, Marvel MaXimum Collection is the perfect assortment of nostalgia for fans everywhere!

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for The Secret of Crystal Mountain, an upcoming adventure RPG starring a cat in a magical world from solo developer Chris Rosenthal. The new trailer for The Secret of Crystal Mountain showcases revamped visuals, main character design, and mechanics. The Secret of Crystal Mountain will be available on PC and Mac via Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2027.

Guide Maroon, a Delivery Cat bringing a letter to the top of Crystal Mountain Isle, on a journey inspired by classic action-adventure titles with modern design sensibilities. Despite being a seasoned traveler, Maroon quickly learns this delivery is unlike any before. The power of Crystal Mountain Isle, once the source of all known magic, now fades in the aftermath of war.

Maroon and his trusty avian companion take up the mantle of adventurers and embark on a quest to restore elemental crystals and return magic to its former power.
title: The Secret of Crystal Mountain - Official Gameplay Trailer

description:

The trailer also features the song “Tell Me When the World Stops Ending” by synthwave band Gunship.

John Carpenter's Toxic Commando will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on March 12, 2026.

description: Nested Lands is out now in Early Access on PC via Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG. description:

Discover Breaker’s Reach, a mysterious mechanical biome in which new enemies – Geobot Miners, Geobot Patrollers and Geobot Scourers – protect its valuable resources, and take the fight to the Void with the powerful new Scrap Minigun and scorching new Flamethrower. 

The Void & Voltage free update is available today (February 25) to all Core Keeper players on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the brutal animated trailer for Nightmare Reaper, which reveals that a new update will bring co-op gameplay and improved New Game+ to the retro-inspired first-person shooter game. Nightmare Reaper's free multiplayer update will be available on March 17, 2026.

The multiplayer update will feature a co-op mode where 4 players can play the entire campaign together, including New Game+. The update will also feature a very unique deathmatch mode where players can create custom game modes and fight with randomly generated weapons. Also included in the update are new elite enemies, 15 "shiny" weapon variants with new mechanics, a new minigame, and a new skill tree that will provide high-level content for New Game+ as well as a pile of bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

#NightmareReaper #Gaming #IGN
title: Nightmare Reaper - Official Multiplayer Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Kestrel Mk. II takes the spotlight in this latest Elite Dangerous trailer for the space sim game. The Kestrel Mk. II is Elite Dangerous' first ship of 2026, and it is available today in ARX Early Access.

A small frame capable of delivering a big impact, the Kestrel Mk II has been designed to break convention and challenge Elite Dangerous’ heavy-hitting combat ships with a manoeuvrable and aggressive loadout. Complimented by three large hardpoints and a pair of new modules; The Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator, a fully automatic variant of the existing Shock Cannon, which utilises the ship’s fuel as ammunition, and the Mk II Agile Boost Thrusters, which offer significant lateral and vertical acceleration when boosting, creating an evasive fighter which packs a punch.
title: Elite Dangerous - Official Kestrel Mk. II Launch Trailer
